title: Lettuce Wraps

items: 1 lb ground pork or ground chicken
1 can (8 oz) water chestnuts, drained and diced
1 head butter lettuce (about 12 leaves), leaves separated

steps: Stir the hoisin, soy sauce, rice vinegar and sriracha in a small bowl. Separate the lettuce leaves, rinse and pat dry.

Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add the meat and cook 6–8 min, breaking it into small crumbles, until browned with no pink left. Pork should read 160°F and chicken 165°F. Spoon off extra fat if using pork.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir 30–60 sec, until fragrant.
Add the water chestnuts and sauce. Cook 2 min, stirring, until the sauce coats the meat and looks glossy.
Spoon about ⅓ cup filling into each lettuce cup and top with scallions.
tips: Dry the lettuce well or the cups get watery.
Add 1 cup diced mushrooms or a diced bell pepper with the meat for more vegetables.
Serve any extra filling over rice.
storage: Filling keeps in the fridge up to 4 days or the freezer up to 3 months. Reheat in a skillet over medium heat or in the microwave until hot (165°F). Store the lettuce separately, wrapped in a damp paper towel, up to 3 days.
